items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Viola McCoy in the context of Cliff Smith's career (1925), but the interviewee (Maxine Sullivan) does not mention knowing, meeting, or working with Viola McCoy.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, on the wire recorder. I don't know when I'm ever going to get a chance to hear that.

I see by your notes here, I've mentioned earlier that it was around 1926 that Cliff came to New York, but I see it was 1923 and when he came in 1923, he joined Lionel Howard's Musical Aces and also around 1925 he accompanied singers like Viola McCoy, Lena Wilson, Clara Smith and Sarah-- I don't know who this person is --
